experiments.scope: Exercises the binding geometry, Lemmas B', B'', C and C1, the counted charges (H5') and the post-filter chain (H1-P1) at reduced size (proof.md Sections 3-6, 12); with about ten claws per trial it checks exactness, not rates. Trials 0..3: first blocks from SHAKE-256 of the seed until the real 38-step chaining value is in the kept class ((cv0 >> 24) & 63) == 12 (Section 3.8), and that chaining value; r, ustart and 512 selected sub-blocks (2^17 a0) from the seed; the binding 15 x 2^19 table of six-lane 256-bit buckets built from 2^17 consecutive words u (about 1,900 entries; retention is exercised in the parent's C port and in selftest), and the counted scan: every read runs the combined tag and C1 test (Section 3.6); lanes passing both run the rest of the single-s0 chain and step 3b on every good pair. Checks: tag-only claws against an independent search over the retained entries (claws_equal_ref) and by rebuilding the real E16 (claw_e16_bad = 0); C1-claws against that search restricted to C1 on the real words (c1_claws_equal_ref); their post-filter flags against the real words (postfilter_ref_mismatch = 0). A pair is returned only if step 3b accepts; none is expected at this size. Trial 4: step 3b on the P8 pair. Trial 5: the tag-only test of Lemma B' for every kind, w and tag, and the combined test of Lemma B'' on 16,128 lanes (edge values of PHI and E5; every lane class at every lane position). Trial 6: the bitsliced front end on 16 batches against the scalar predicate, and gbs_worst. Trial 7: the window's rates (Section 3.7): 2^15 draws of a1 in C1&C2, a0 uniform in SEL and in W9; G and F7 counts. Trial 8: the class's F7 rate (Section 3.8, H9): 2^15 draws of the same law; for each G pair, F7 with 16 values of cv[0] uniform in the kept class and 16 uniform over all words (expected 0.1206148 and |F7|/2^32 per test; the class count varies by about 8% with the q-to-q spread). Trials 9..255 return no pair by design.
experiments.hypothesis: Returned pairs: 0 (none expected at the reduced size; any returned pair is a full collision). Trials 0..3: claws_equal_ref = 1, c1_claws_equal_ref = 1, claw_e16_bad = 0, postfilter_ref_mismatch = 0, distinct_pairs = claws, probes/a0 near 250/8192 and reads/probes near 31.2, claws consistent with expected_claws_milli/1000 = 160 x entries x 2^17 / 2^32 (Poisson) and c1_claws about claws/8. Trial 4: step3b_P8_pair_ok = 1, step3b_P8_pair_ops = 3014. Trial 5: probe_lanes_checked = 2304, probe_mismatches = 0, c1test_lanes_checked = 16128, c1test_mismatches = 0, c1test_firing_lanes > 0. Trial 7: sel_ok = 1, g_sel near g_sel_exp_milli/1000 (about 2.27 x g_w9), g_w9 near g_w9_exp_milli/1000, f7_sel near 0.067 g_sel and f7_w9 near 0.067 g_w9. Trial 8: f7_cls near f7_cls_exp_milli/1000 (about 1.8 x f7_all) and f7_all near f7_all_exp_milli/1000. Trial 6: bs_mismatches = 0, bs_gates_max <= bs_gate_bound = bs_gate_worst = 218, bs_probing_lanes near 16 x 256 x 250/8192 = 125.

experiments.scope: Checks claw exactness and the row-16 gate on more frequent claws, with a different (full-frame) coverage geometry, and reports the rows 16..21 cumulative counts of every claw (proof.md Sections 3, 6, 9, 12); it is not a measurement of q3. Trials 0..3: first blocks from SHAKE-256 of the seed until the real chaining value is in the kept class (Section 3.8), and that chaining value; full-frame coverage (all 1024 columns, so every scanned u is covered and both windows probe) over 2^16 consecutive words u, and 2^13 consecutive a0 of W9; every claw of the tag-only diagnostic is checked against the independent search and its real E16 at the head and offset the scan named (row16_bad = 0), the C1-claws of the counted scan against the independent search restricted to C1 on the real words (c1_claws_equal_ref) and their post-filter flags against the real words, and both members are rebuilt and the tests of rows 16..21 of step 3b applied in order (cumulative rows_le16..rows_le21). Trial 4 runs step 3b on the P8 pair. Trial 5: the exact good-pair sampler of msample.c (Section 3.8, H9) at reduced size, 64 pairs per side with cv[0] uniform (all) and uniform in the kept class (cls): every pair's E16 is rebuilt against its target and its four post-filter flags against the real words; P8's dW23 (XOR) and dW25 counts per side. The profile rate (about 1.5 x 10^-4) is measured by msample.c at 10^8 pairs per side, not here. No pair is returned by design (acceptance is about 2^-71 per good pair).
experiments.hypothesis: Returned pairs: 0 by design. Trials 0..3: claws_equal_ref = 1, c1_claws_equal_ref = 1, row16_bad = 0, postfilter_ref_mismatch = 0, rows_le16 = claws, and the stage counts c1_claws, c1c2 consistent with the rates 1/8 and 2^-6.34 of proof.md Section 6. Trial 4: step3b_P8_pair_ok = 1, step3b_P8_pair_ops = 3014. Trial 5: e16_bad_all = e16_bad_cls = 0, pf_bad_all = pf_bad_cls = 0, dw23 near 8 per side, dw25 near 0.
